dossier.scp_unleashed.005.title: Skeleton Key
dossier.scp_unleashed.005.caption: SCP-005 at intake, photographed beside its evidence tag.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-005 is kept in a glass-fronted storage container in a low-security wing, under continuous camera observation. The container is not locked, as no lock would hold it. Security of SCP-005 depends entirely on control of the personnel who can reach it.

SCP-005 may be removed only for approved testing, by a team of no fewer than two, and must be returned before the end of the shift. **SCP-005 is never to be carried past the door of any containment chamber.**
Any door found open without explanation is to be treated as possible use of SCP-005 until the key has been sighted in its container.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-005 is a skeleton key 18 cm long, cast in a brass alloy. It has a looped bow set with three small knobs, a round barrel ringed by three collars, and a stepped bit of five wards. Wear along the barrel suggests long use. No maker's mark has been found.

When the bit of SCP-005 is presented to any door, hatch, trapdoor or gate, the closure opens. No keyhole is required. Locks, bolts, keycard readers and powered seals are all disregarded, and the closure opens by its own mechanism, exactly as if it had been operated normally.

A closure opened in this way stays open for an interval that the holder appears to choose, from a few seconds to indefinitely, and then closes of its own accord. Turning SCP-005 over in the hand changes the interval. If anything else opens or closes the closure in the meantime, SCP-005 lets it go.
A faint, cold sheen passes along the key every few seconds. It has never appeared in a photograph.

page.title: Addendum 005-1: Test Log
text: Test 005-09: iron door, no signal applied. Opened, then closed again when the interval ran out.
Test 005-13: blast gate held shut by its controls. Opened. The controls still read shut.
Test 005-17: a door held open by SCP-005 was shut by hand. SCP-005 made no further attempt on it.
Test 005-22: a subject inside SCP-002 tried SCP-005 on the inner face of the bulkhead. No effect. %rSubject not recovered.%r

page.title: Addendum 005-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-005 has no recovery record. It was handed to a reader of this file by an unidentified individual in Foundation dress, the same individual described in the files of other objects. The individual did not say where the key came from, only which doors it should not be used on. %rThat list was not written down.%r See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp005_key.tooltip: An old brass key. It fits every lock it meets.
item.scp_unleashed.scp005_key.use: Use on any door, trapdoor or gate to force it open
item.scp_unleashed.scp005_key.bypass: Ignores keycard scanners and redstone locks
item.scp_unleashed.scp005_key.refresh: Use a door it is holding to restart the timer
item.scp_unleashed.scp005_key.cycle: Sneak-use in the air or on a block to change the hold time
item.scp_unleashed.scp005_key.release: Sneak-use a door it is holding to let it close
message.scp_unleashed.scp005_key.release: The lock settles back into place
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp005_key.1: SCP-005 is an ornate skeleton key that opens any door, trapdoor or gate it is used on, including facility doors locked behind keycard scanners or redstone.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp005_key.2: A door it opens stays open for the key's hold time (3, 5, 10, 30 or 60 seconds, or until released), then closes itself, unless something else has opened or closed it in the meantime.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp005_key.3: Sneak-use the key in the air or on any other block to change the hold time. Use a held door again to restart its timer, or sneak-use it to let it close at once.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp005_key.4: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-005 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A few minutes later a stranger in Foundation dress finds you and hands the key over.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp005.0: The courier is the same figure noted in other files.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp005.1: Wait somewhere open. A locked door will not keep it out.
